pending_commit.commit_message: FROMLIST: drivers: qcom: add command DB driver Command DB is a simple database in the shared memory of QCOM SoCs, that provides information regarding shared resources. Some shared resources in the SoC have properties that are probed dynamically at boot by the remote processor. The information pertaining to the SoC and the platform are made available in the shared memory. Drivers can query this information using predefined strings. Signed-off-by: Mahesh Sivasubramanian <msivasub@codeaurora.org> Signed-off-by: Lina Iyer <ilina@codeaurora.org> Reviewed-by: Bjorn Andersson <bjorn.andersson@linaro.org> Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org> Conflicts to both files were caused simply by nearby additions. remote_try: Remove buildbot specific behaviors. Since we have shutdown buildbot tryjobs, we can cleanup buildbot specific behaviors in remote_try.py. This removes: Tryjob descriptions. Multiple build configs per request. swarming option. Description/option size limits. Build column detection. Alternate buckets. Also, a variety of properties are no longer used by the swarming recipe, but had to be sent for the buildbot recipe, and so they are now removed. They were all unused, or duplicates. bot email extra_args name owners user BUG=None TEST=run_tests lib/remote_try_unitetsst --network Assorted manual tryjob requests. This includes removing the concept of a CL description. This was used in the buildbot waterfall display, and is no longer needed or support Change-Id: I8b389607ae8b1f65345a0c08e0e0c6efacf2ef49 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1003998 Commit-Ready: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Tested-by: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Paul Hobbs <phobbs@google.com> Reviewed-by: Jinjing Liang <jinjingl@google.com>

anx7447: Add functions to the anx7447 driver to check/erase OCM flash This CL adds support to check if the OCM flash is erased and if not, will erase it at initialization time. These changes are encapsulated in a new config option CONFIG_USB_PD_TCPM_ANX7447_OCM_ERASE and this option is enabled for Yorp boards. BUG=b:77658388 BRANCH=NONE TEST=make -j buildall. Tested on a board that hadn't yet been erased. Verifed the message "anx7447: OCM flash checked and successfully erased" was in the EC log, but did not show up on subsequent reboots. Change-Id: I660e76a9498d3dc1ba821a04317b324f716c5089 Signed-off-by: Scott Collyer <scollyer@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/988414 Commit-Ready: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org> Tested-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Daisuke Nojiri <dnojiri@chromium.org>

yorp: use cbi for board version Replace ADC-based board version with CBI/EEPROM board version. This will cause all of the existing boards to report -1 (or 65535) as their board version until you can update it from the kernel. To set your board version to 0 run the following command in the AP console when WP if off (e.g. battery removed) $ ectool cbi set 0 0 1 2 BRANCH=none BUG=b:77551185,b:77900842 TEST=wrote to cbi from ap console and verify flash state on ap and ec console Change-Id: I03987cc89ca4c14580dcf61de23780fe5304663b Signed-off-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1008832 Reviewed-by: Aaron Durbin <adurbin@chromium.org>

run_oci: Support 'precreate' hooks This CL allows config.json to have 'precreate' hooks that are executed before the container is created. The new hooks allows ARC to run all arc-setup calls via config.json. Previously, two arc-setup calls were via Upstart (in a synchronous manner which is discouraged to use) and one was via config.json. With this CL, we can move the Upstart ones to config.json removing the synchronous Upstart calls. BUG=b:77594722 TEST=FEATURES=test emerge-$BOARD run_oci Change-Id: I150bb4af74320c41f189ad931d7e9556b168c4ad Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1010902 Commit-Ready: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org>
